description: Elections Commission - Amended Notice for Local Authorities in Monaragala District (Order under Section 38(3) of the L. A. E. O.)
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with the postponement of local authority elections, including the announcement of a new election date (April 25, 2023) for multiple Pradeshiya Sabhas. It references the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and contains a formal notice of poll change, which falls squarely under election processes and scheduling - the core focus of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
